s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic systemic infection with granulomatous inflammation and multi-organ involvement
salient_findings: Progressively worsening fever, weight loss, night sweats, and dry cough
Painful nonhealing ulcer on the right hallux with necrotizing granulomatous inflammation
Chronic lower back pain with contiguous spondylitis and spinal cord compression
key_facts: Negative sputum GeneXpert tests at local clinics
Bilateral reticular-nodular opacities on chest radiograph
Induced sputum trace positive for MTB on GeneXpert
MTB sensitive to rifampicin and isoniazid
Necrotizing granulomatous inflammation with a solitary acid-fast bacillus on toe ulcer biopsy

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic systemic infection with granulomatous inflammation and multi-organ involvement
salient_findings: Progressively worsening fever, weight loss, night sweats, and dry cough
Painful nonhealing ulcer on the right hallux with necrotizing granulomatous inflammation
Chronic lower back pain with contiguous spondylitis and spinal cord compression
key_facts: Negative sputum GeneXpert tests at local clinics
Bilateral reticular-nodular opacities on chest radiograph
Induced sputum trace positive for MTB on GeneXpert
MTB sensitive to rifampicin and isoniazid
Necrotizing granulomatous inflammation with a solitary acid-fast bacillus on toe ulcer biopsy

shortlist.label: Tuberculosis
shortlist.why_kept: Confirmed by induced sputum GeneXpert and MTB culture, with evidence of disseminated disease

shortlist.label: Sarcoidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Granulomatous inflammation and multi-organ involvement, although less likely given positive MTB tests

shortlist.label: Crohn's disease
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic systemic symptoms and granulomatous inflammation, but less likely given absence of gastrointestinal symptoms

shortlist.label: Infectious osteomyelitis
shortlist.why_kept: Spondylitis and discitis on MRI, with possible infectious etiology

shortlist.label: Brucellosis
shortlist.why_kept: Systemic infection with granulomatous inflammation, although less likely given positive MTB tests and absence of exposure history

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms and test results, including a 2-year history of progressively worsening fever, weight loss, night sweats, and a dry cough, along with induced sputum trace positive for MTB on GeneXpert and subsequent growth of MTB sensitive to rifampicin and isoniazid, strongly support the diagnosis of tuberculosis. Additionally, the presence of necrotizing granulomatous inflammation with a solitary acid-fast bacillus on toe ulcer biopsy and contiguous spondylitis from T6 to T10 with discitis and an epidural/paraspinal collection causing spinal cord compression on MRI of the spine are consistent with disseminated TB.

rejected.label: Sarcoidosis
rejected.why: While sarcoidosis can cause granulomatous inflammation, the presence of acid-fast bacilli and positive MTB culture are more indicative of tuberculosis.

rejected.label: Crohn's disease
rejected.why: Crohn's disease can cause systemic symptoms and granulomatous inflammation, but it does not typically cause acid-fast bacilli or positive MTB culture.

rejected.label: Infectious osteomyelitis
rejected.why: Infectious osteomyelitis can cause localized infection, but it does not explain the patient's systemic symptoms or the presence of acid-fast bacilli and positive MTB culture.

rejected.label: Brucellosis
rejected.why: Brucellosis can cause systemic symptoms and granulomatous inflammation, but it does not typically cause acid-fast bacilli or positive MTB culture, and the patient's symptoms and test results are more consistent with tuberculosis.
